description: This file implements time-related functions for the jemalloc memory allocator, including initialization, comparison, arithmetic operations, and platform-specific time retrieval methods.

methods.name: nstime_init
methods.description: Initializes a nstime_t structure with a given nanosecond value.

methods.name: nstime_init2
methods.description: Initializes a nstime_t structure with seconds and nanoseconds.

methods.name: nstime_ns
methods.description: Returns the total nanoseconds from a nstime_t structure.

methods.name: nstime_msec
methods.description: Returns the milliseconds from a nstime_t structure.

methods.name: nstime_sec
methods.description: Returns the seconds from a nstime_t structure.

methods.name: nstime_nsec
methods.description: Returns the nanoseconds part of a nstime_t structure.

methods.name: nstime_copy
methods.description: Copies one nstime_t structure to another.

methods.name: nstime_add
methods.description: Adds a nstime_t addend to a nstime_t time.

methods.name: nstime_iadd
methods.description: Adds an integer nanosecond value to a nstime_t time.

methods.name: nstime_subtract
methods.description: Subtracts a nstime_t subtrahend from a nstime_t time.

methods.name: nstime_isubtract
methods.description: Subtracts an integer nanosecond value from a nstime_t time.

methods.name: nstime_imultiply
methods.description: Multiplies a nstime_t time by a multiplier.

methods.name: nstime_idivide
methods.description: Divides a nstime_t time by a divisor.

methods.name: nstime_divide
methods.description: Divides one nstime_t by another, returning the ratio.

methods.name: nstime_monotonic
methods.description: Function pointer indicating if the clock is monotonic.

methods.name: nstime_update
methods.description: Function pointer to update the current time, handling non-monotonic clocks.
